nit.description: Text: خرابی کے ساتھ مکمل ہوا. Aspect differs from its siblings: title.finished = 'مکمل ہو گیا' and title.stopped_error = 'خرابی کے ساتھ رک گیا' use the completive compound; this one uses simple past 'ہوا'. Grammatical and correct meaning; parallel form would be 'خرابی کے ساتھ مکمل ہو گیا'. Gating: false.

Keys: ui.agents.config.summary.change.kind / class_proactive / class_reactive. Text: قسم بدل گئی / قسم بدل کر پیش قدم ہو گئی / قسم بدل کر جوابی ہو گئی. Both 'kind' and 'class' render as قسم, so a summary line could read two قسم phrases with different referents. This follows the existing glossary (class → قسم in ui.agents.refusals.class.install_disclosure 'پھر اس کی قسم مقرر ہوتی ہے'; kind → قسم in ui.agents.teams.field.member_kind_aria), and the class phrases are disambiguated by پیش قدم/جوابی, so not a defect; optional only if the glossary is ever split. Gating: false.

scope: The 55 keys this branch adds to en ui.agents.config (47) and ui.agents.teams (8) (git diff origin/main...HEAD), audited in the uncommitted ur working-tree files at the hashes below. Existing ur keys used as glossary context only; verified unchanged vs origin/main (0 changed, 0 removed, 0 extra, 0 missing).
head: f6e6260da1

checks.hash_precheck: both ur hashes recomputed with shasum -a 256 and matched the brief before auditing
checks.icu: python brace/select/plural parser: placeholder names and select arms (agent/team/skill/other) identical for all 55; plurals tools_added/tools_removed use one/other with # in both arms (ur CLDR one/other). In *_named step keys {name} moved inside every select arm; still isolated because plainArgumentNames walks select options (src/i18n/bidi.ts:76-113).
checks.agreement: select arms agree: ایجنٹ masc (بنایا/کیا جا رہا ہے), ٹیم/مہارت/تعریف fem (بنائی/کی جا رہی ہے); plurals ایجنٹس پڑھے/جانچے گئے vs ٹیمیں/مہارتیں/تعریفیں پڑھی/جانچی گئیں; oblique ٹیموں/مہارتوں/تعریفوں before پر.
checks.english_left: Only 'Local Operator' (product name, never translated per context; existing ur copy writes it in Latin, e.g. ui.agents.skills.alert.builtin_body). Loanwords match existing Urdu-script usage: بیک اینڈ, اپ ڈیٹ, انسٹال, ٹولز, کنفیگریشن رن, آن/آف.
checks.glossary: ایجنٹ/ایجنٹس, ٹیم/ٹیمیں, مہارت, تعریف, منتظم, ارکان, ہدایات, تفصیل, کوشش کا درجہ (ui.agents.models.override.tier_field), تفویض, پیش قدم/جوابی (ui.agents.refusals.class.label.*), “تبدیلی طلب کریں” (ui.agents.detail.action.ask_change), team errors parallel ui.agents.detail.create/edit.* agent siblings.
checks.punctuation: Sentences end ۔, lists use ، ; status headings and step lines carry no trailing punctuation as context requires; ellipsis … kept on placeholder.working and disabled.connecting; seed_prompt keeps trailing ': ' (same ASCII colon as existing ui.agents.detail.ask_change_prefill).
checks.bidi_controls: 0 bidi control characters (U+200E/F, U+202A-E, U+2066-9, U+061C) in either ur file.
checks.bidi_isolation: t() wraps Latin-led string arguments in FSI…PDI only for RTL catalogues: src/i18n/messages.ts:242-244 calls isolateArguments (src/i18n/bidi.ts:131-145; needsIsolation bidi.ts:117-124). FSI is the dir=auto isolate; UBA P2 skips isolate content, so a dir=auto container whose string starts with {name} (installing_named, reading_named, error_name_taken) still resolves RTL from the following Urdu. No string has an LTR placeholder directly before a trailing ۔ or :, except seed_prompt, which is rendered with translateRaw (no isolates, by design: src/renderer/src/features/agents/config-run/seed-prompt.ts:19-29) and has Urdu between {name} and the colon, so the colon stays at the logical end. members '({before} سے {after})' takes numbers, not strings; parentheses mirror and digit runs keep order. Verdict: no reordering defect.
checks.fit: Status headings and group headings stay a few words; step-line ICU sources grew because the verb moved into each arm, but each rendered arm is 3-6 words.

observations_not_findings: Code, pre-existing, out of translation scope: config-composer.tsx:910-916 joins change phrases with a hard-coded ASCII ', ' and prefixes ': ', so an Urdu summary shows a Latin comma between phrases where ur copy uses '،' (cf. ui.agents.starters.summary.separator = '، '). Not introduced by this branch's ur strings; recorded for the owner, does not gate.
